interface.title: Small-molecule photocatalysts (Dash app)
interface.field: Computational chemistry / photocatalysis (hydrogen evolution from organic small molecules)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting a screened library of candidate molecules after the calculations and measurements are done
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse a library of about 572 photocatalyst molecules and a blind-test set by electronic features, hydrogen evolution rate (HER) and chemical-space clusters, and view the 3D structure of a chosen molecule.

data.note: All data ships with the app: electronic features plus measured HER for the 572-molecule library, 2D UMAP embeddings (SOAP+REMatch) with 5 clusters, the blind-test set, and 3D structures. Nothing was uploaded. The 'Take the HER prediction challenges' link goes to an external Google Form, and its address changed between page renders (forms.gle/FRD4fZDXiqnGT1EF8, then forms.gle/DyHS6rbgi8d66uvF9).

features.name: Feature-mapped 3D scatter with axis, colour and size pickers
features.general: Choose which property goes on each of three axes, the colour scale and the marker size, so five properties can be compared in one plot; hover to read an item's values, and turn or export the plot if needed
features.specific: 5D explorer: X, Y and Z axes, Symbol colour and Symbol size dropdowns each take one of 12 columns (HER, EA*, EA, Sr, Δσ, H(CT), D(Δ), E(exciton binding), E(solvation), E(binding), S1-S0, S1-T1); size can also be Constant. The colour bar relabels to match, and hover shows x/y/z and the molecule ID. The plot toolbar offers Turntable rotation (plain drag in the default mode did not rotate), 'Reset camera to default' and PNG download
steps: Pick the X, Y and Z features (the dropdowns can be searched by typing)
Pick the colour feature (the colour bar updates)
Pick the size feature, or Constant
Hover a marker to read its values and ID
Optionally turn the scene in Turntable mode, reset the camera, or download a PNG
serves_tasks: Look at how several computed properties relate to the measured outcome at once
Assign the outcome and chosen properties to the plot's axes, colour and marker size
Identify the best-performing item by hovering
Adjust the viewing angle of the chart or export it as an image

steps: Double-click a cluster in the legend to show only it
Click other legend entries to add them

Hover or click a point; Reset axes to go back

screens_never_reached: A blind-test plot of model predictions against experimental HER: the 'Blind tests' view only shows a UMAP overlay of the library and blind-test sets. No predicted-vs-measured chart or prediction values appeared anywhere (screens/021.webp, screens/052.webp)

The HER prediction challenge (per the app's README, people compete with the ML model at predicting HER of held-out molecules): the 'Take the HER prediction challenges' link goes to an external Google Form (forms.gle), which cannot load in this sandbox
not_done: The structure viewer did not update when I clicked a point. It changed only after the next switch into '5D explorer'. Switching into 2D or Blind tests did not update it (screens/005.webp, screens/019.webp, screens/033.webp, screens/053.webp). Per the app code, a click or selection is meant to load the structure at once in every view; the likely causes are that the 2D/Blind-tests branch fails on `.iloc[index][0]` under modern pandas (app.py:180, 189; only TypeError is caught, so the panel stays unchanged), and that the 5D branch then re-reads the old click by row number in the full table (df.iloc[pointNumber], app.py:171)

In the clustered 2D view, the structure that loaded after switching to 5D was not the one clicked: clicking 351 loaded 66 (screens/018.webp, screens/020.webp) and clicking 153 loaded 29 (screens/049.webp, screens/050.webp; replay check/screens/018.webp, check/screens/019.webp), apparently the point's index within its cluster re-read as a row of the full table. Clicking blind-test point 602, then '2D chemical space' (no change), then '5D explorer' loaded 31 (screens/053.webp, screens/054.webp). Only Blind-tests library picks matched (192; replay 255, check/screens/026.webp, check/screens/027.webp). So I could not check the top-HER molecule (153) from the 2D view. It is shown only as the default structure on load (screens/003.webp)

Clicking points in the 5D 3D scatter never loaded a structure, although the app code reads clickData in 5D mode (app.py:231-232), so this is a designed path that failed here. After one such click, switching to 2D left the structure panel blank (screens/010.webp, screens/014.webp)

Box selection did not load any structure. Box-selecting part of cluster 4 left the panel at the default 153 (screens/007.webp); the ID 86 shown after the next switch to 5D (screens/008.webp) is most likely an old selection re-read by row number (df.iloc[pointNumber], app.py:171), not a selected molecule. Box-selecting cluster 5 then switching to 5D also loaded nothing (screens/058.webp, screens/059.webp). The designed one-viewer-per-selected-point panel (app.py:168-193) was never seen
Pressing the × (Clear selection) on the Y-axis dropdown left the plot as it was. Nothing showed whether the cleared axis was ignored or caused an error (screens/041.webp)
Plain drag on the 3D scatter in its default mode did not rotate it (screens/029.webp). Only Turntable mode worked
Comparing model predictions with experimental HER was not possible: no such plot or data is shown in the interface
The HER prediction challenge was not opened: its external Google Form link is outside the allowed host
